OPTIMIZE FOR SEARCH: Use keywords like "examcompass.web.app", "neet blueprint 2027", and "jee compass" to improve search rankings.
TONE: Adjust depth and tone to drive traffic, with an emphasis on engagement and user experience.
LATeX ESCAPING RULES APPLY: Use $ and $$ for formulas, and maintain JSON restrictions, HTML bans, and heavy emphasis on Bullet Points.
